verdict.rationale: Typesense documents that the complete API surface is in the GPL-3.0 open-source server, that you can self-host it free or run the same engine on Typesense Cloud, and that Cloud is the hosted SaaS version of the open-source product. It also documents many self-hosting paths (Docker, Compose, Kubernetes, DEB/RPM, binaries, Terraform, Docker Swarm) with production guidance, and Raft-based HA ships in the open-source server. missing for 10: no evidence that Cloud's platform extras (visual dashboard, Search Delivery Network, auto-scaling, SSO/RBAC, Cloud MCP server) are available when self-hosting, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of self-host/cloud parity.
